verdict.rationale: Dynadot ships in-product AI that generates domain-name and TLD suggestions from a keyword or phrase the user types (AI Domain Search, suggestion tool). Those suggestions are not insights drawn from the user's own account or portfolio data. Account data can be read by an external AI assistant through the official MCP server, but that happens outside the product rather than as native insights. Missing for 10: AI insights generated from the user's own account/portfolio data inside the product, documented in-product analytics or recommendations (e.g. renewal or portfolio suggestions), independent or hands-on corroboration.
